vision.name: Android Battle Rush
vision.text:
([Trait:Android] only.)
[Attack] Physical attack.
Destroy an opponent's Setup, Drill, or Ally. [Warning]: Your opponent may discard a card from their hand. If they do not, destroy an opponent's Setup, Drill, or Ally.
DAMAGE: 4 life cards.
(Banish after use.)
vision.note: grey card; inline icon grey R badge (Android); similar to S16 BST_45 'Android Battle Rush' (R45) but not compared word for word; black warning triangle transcribed as [Warning]; no Endurance badge
